prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE implementation-oriented 2.5D gameplay concept for Last Chance Resort's futuristic enclosed volleyball arena.
Input image 1: reference for the arena idea, two adult players in teal and coral, gift-delivery drones, spring and porter hazards, fixed side-view court. REDESIGN into a much simpler practical indie 2.5D game, not a cinematic 3D render.
Primary request: show what this futuristic indoor arena could actually look like in a small browser physics game using a few layered background images, shaded 2D cutout sprites and simple animation. The image itself should look like a playable side-view game screenshot, with attractive clear art, not an explanatory diagram.
Composition: landscape 16:10. Fully orthographic fixed side view. Straight floor at 86% height, narrow horizontal light rim over a shallow dark solid base, no giant foreground slab. Slim metal side walls at outer 3%, small cyan left and coral right service buttons. Center volleyball net exactly edge-on: thin vertical pole at x50% from floor to y63%, only a tiny edge of mesh, no broad net. Plenty of free space above players for ball movement. Adult standing player height 19-20% of total frame. Men and women have believable but simplified anatomy with softly shaded solid shapes and visibly articulated limbs that could rotate as separate textured sprite segments, no hyperreal skin or muscles.
Environment: an ENCLOSED FUTURISTIC INDOOR SPORTS HALL, completely replacing all beach elements. Only three visibly simple background depth layers: a muted flat dark-blue rear wall divided into large rectangular panels; a few evenly repeated chunky structural ribs with restrained cyan strip lamps and small amber indicator lamps; the foreground court edge and barriers. Ceiling shown as a simple flat overhead beam with repeated supports, NOT a massive cathedral dome. No windows, outdoor scenery, palms, plant beds, terraces, sea or skyline. Broad quiet background shapes and clean shallow bevels. Convey volume through gentle baked shading, slight layer parallax cues and small contact shadows; no strong perspective, mirror floor reflections, volumetric light or photoreal textures.
Players: dark-haired adult man in teal shorts at x31%, airborne in an awkward backwards tumble with legs bent; ponytailed adult woman in coral sportswear at x71%, jumping to hit one small yellow-blue-white volleyball at x63% y56%. Keep bodies and limbs fully separated from props, normal proportions, expressive ragdoll poses.
Drones: TWO obvious compact gift-delivery QUADCOPTERS at x23% y38% and x76% y37%, each rendered as a clean shaded sprite, ivory body with teal or orange accents, four simple arm-and-rotor assemblies with thin blurred propeller discs, no wings or insect design. Each visibly holds one gift box BELOW the body on a short straight claw, ribbon shown as a simple cross and bow. Rotor span about 9% image width, gift width about 4%. No complicated cables.
Hazards on the floor: x18% a simple compact orange SPRING robot consisting of a round base, an exposed large shiny coil and a flat ivory cap, visually compressing beneath the tumbling man; x86% a small EXPRESS PORTER robot, ivory capsule body on two dark wheels, teal face screen, small luggage rack with one orange suitcase, moving left with only two short restrained speed lines. Hazards approximately 12% frame height. Give each hazard a crisp readable silhouette with limited independent parts, not intricate machinery.
Art direction: polished but affordable 2.5D indie game art, shaded 2D sprites with modest volume, soft painted gradients, clean edges, simple materials, limited detail and restrained effects. Consistent light direction across sprites. Teal/coral gameplay accents on a quiet navy/graphite arena. Readable at small browser game scale. Keep every interactive object on a single 2D gameplay plane. Make the simplification unmistakable relative to the reference image.
Avoid: cinematic photoreal 3D, massive domed architecture, exaggerated depth, huge characters, perspective floor court, ornate intricate machines, huge glowing effects, reflections, particles, motion blur covering subjects, text, captions, labels, UI, arrows, asset sheets, split views, collage, watermark.
